title: TicketRecord
description: One complete multi-turn customer support interaction. Design-time contract for schema version 1.0.0; the implementation generates this file from the Pydantic model and CI diff-checks it against this committed copy.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH semver of the schema this record was written against (FR-002a).

record_id.description: Stable identifier, unique within an artifact (FR-003, FR-020).

run_id.description: Identifies the producing run; resolves to a RunManifest (FR-003).

source_id.description: Source or template this record derives from (FR-003).

upstream_record_id.description: Present on derived records; preserves the originating record ID (FR-025).

turns.description: Ordered conversation turns. Ordering and role alternation are enforced by the invariant checks, not by this schema (FR-018).

index.description: Position in the conversation; ascends contiguously from 0 (FR-018).

content.description: Utterance text. Any Unicode is valid; emptiness and whitespace-only content are reported by the invariant checks (FR-018).

timestamp.description: If present, must fall within the ticket's created/resolved bounds (FR-006c).

resolved_at.description: Must not precede created_at; required when resolution_status is 'resolved' (FR-006c).
